description: One row per payment gateway. Replaces the per-gateway Settings doctypes: adding a gateway is a record, not a new doctype. Frappe finds this through the Payment Gateway record's Gateway Settings / Gateway Controller fields.

fields.description: Must match the Payment Gateway record exactly -- that is how Frappe links the two.
fields.label: Gateway Name

fields.description: Router takes no money -- it only shows the customer the method chooser.
fields.label: Type

fields.description: A gateway appears on the customer's chooser only while this is ticked.
fields.label: Enabled
How This Appears To The Customer

fields.description: The button text on the chooser, e.g. "Debit Card".
fields.label: Method Label

fields.default: Choose how you would like to pay
fields.description: Shown at the top of the chooser page.
fields.label: Chooser Heading

fields.description: Where money taken through THIS gateway is deposited. Overrides the account on the Payment Request, which belongs to the router and says nothing about which gateway actually took the payment.
fields.label: Deposit Account

fields.description: Stamped on the Payment Entry created when a payment is captured.
fields.label: Mode of Payment

fields.description: How long a payment link stays usable, from when it was issued. 0 means it never expires. A link is refused anyway once the request is paid or cancelled.
fields.label: Link Valid For (Days)

fields.description: 32 characters, used as the AES key. Never appears in any log.
fields.label: Terminal Resource Key

fields.description: Leave blank to use the default for the selected environment.
fields.label: API Endpoint Override

fields.description: Generated in Merchant Administration under Admin > Integration Settings, by an operator holding the "May Configure Integration Settings" privilege. Not the portal login.
fields.label: API Password

fields.description: Confirmed by probing the gateway: 100 is the highest this deployment accepts (101+ return 404 on /information).
fields.label: API Version

fields.description: Generate this in Merchant Administration under Admin > Webhook Notifications, and set the Notification URL there to /api/method/worldshading.payments.web.mpgs_webhook on this site. The gateway sends it back in the X-Notification-Secret header so we can tell a real notification from a forged one.
fields.label: Webhook Notification Secret

fields.description: Shown to the payer on the hosted payment page, so use the trading name.
fields.label: Merchant Display Name

fields.options:
Saving creates or updates the matching Payment Gateway record and points it back here, so Frappe can find this row.

Point your Payment Gateway Account at the Router gateway so payment links offer the customer a choice of method.

Reference: Documentation/payments/

name: WS Payment Gateway
